title: Public Alert No. 018/2026 – Alert on Counterfeit and Unregistered Cerelac Found on Sale
summary: NAFDAC warns of counterfeit and unregistered CERELAC Mixed Fruits and Wheat sold in Lagos, purportedly made by Nestlé Spain, batch 308002910, with tampered/revalidated expiry (10-2026) and a fuel-like odour. Registered packs use a slash in the date; fakes use a hyphen.
